  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

## Company Profile

Founded in May 2004, **Jiangsu BRJ Medical Co., Ltd.** is a leading manufacturer specializing in the
research, development, production, and distribution of high-quality surgical sutures, surgical
needles, and other related medical instruments.

We are committed to providing a wide range of products that meet the highest quality standards both
domestically and internationally. Our products comply with major certifications including **CE, ISO
13485, ISO 14001, ISO 45001**, and we hold all the necessary production licenses to meet global
market requirements. This ensures that every product we manufacture adheres to stringent safety,
reliability, and effectiveness standards.

Over more than two decades, BRJ Medical has grown from a dedicated domestic supplier into a globally
recognized brand, partnering with hospitals, distributors, and healthcare institutions across more
than 50 countries. Our comprehensive product range covers absorbable and non-absorbable sutures,
specialty surgical needles, and a broad portfolio of ancillary medical devices.

## SERVICES**Our Services**

We mainly produce and export disposable medical consumables. In our company, we understand the
critical role that disposable medical consumables play in healthcare settings. These products are
essential for maintaining hygiene, preventing infections, and ensuring the well-being of patients
and healthcare professionals alike. 

Our commitment is to provide top-notch quality products that meet international standards. We are
proud to offer a wide range of disposable medical consumables that includes vacuum blood collection
tubes and needles, gloves, masks, gowns, storage vessels and much more. Each product is meticulously
designed, keeping in mind the specific needs and requirements of medical professionals.

## SERVICES**Our Services**

We mainly produce and export disposable medical consumables. In our company, we understand the
critical role that disposable medical consumables play in healthcare settings. These products are
essential for maintaining hygiene, preventing infections, and ensuring the well-being of patients
and healthcare professionals alike. 

Our commitment is to provide top-notch quality products that meet international standards. We are
proud to offer a wide range of disposable medical consumables that includes vacuum blood collection
tubes and needles, gloves, masks, gowns, storage vessels and much more. Each product is meticulously
designed, keeping in mind the specific needs and requirements of medical professionals.
[Read more ][139]

### Quality and Customized Solutions

International standard medical consumables for diverse healthcare professionals and facilities.

### Timely Delivery and Secure Transit

Efficient dispatch and safe delivery of critical medical supplies.

### Exceptional Customer Support

Dedicated team providing exceptional customer service for long-term relationships.

### Competitive Pricing and High Standards

Quality solutions at competitive prices with superior manufacturing standards.

In today's rapidly advancing medical industry, customization has become paramount. With the constant
need for innovative and personalized medical devices, choosing the right OEM&ODM (Original Equipment
Manufacturer & Original Design Manufacturer) partner is crucial. 
When it comes to Medical Consumables OEM&ODM, our company goes above and beyond to ensure customer
satisfaction. We understand that every medical establishment has unique requirements, and we are
committed to meeting those needs. Whether it's custom packaging, specific product materials, or even

solution.

## Why Work with Us

#### Trusted Manufacturer of Precision Diagnostics

With a proven track record in producing high-quality vacuum and non-vacuum blood and urine
collection tubes, Marcela ensures accuracy, sterility, and safety in every product.

#### Comprehensive Product Range

From EDTA and clot activator tubes to rapid test kits for diseases like malaria, dengue, and
hepatitis, we offer end-to-end solutions for clinical diagnostics and laboratory testing.

#### Committed to Quality & Compliance

Our products are designed with global best practices, engineered stoppers, and tailored
preservatives—ensuring reliable performance and compatibility with all major laboratory protocols.

Our product range

### BLOOD COLLECTION TUBES

###### K2 & K3 EDTA

Marcela EDTA tubes are used in hematology while EDTA salts are widely used as anticoagulant in blood
collection tubes to cover the calcium ions of the blood, therefore preventing blood coagulation.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.58 (2)]

###### CLOT ACTIVATOR

Marcela serum tubes are used to collect serum sample for chemistry, serology, and immunology. The
tubes are coated with micronized silica particles which activate clotting when tubes are gently
inverted.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.58 (1)]

###### SODIUM FLUORIDE

Marcela EDTA/Sodium Fluoride & Sodium Fluoride/Potassium Oxa- late tubes are used in clinical
biochemistry and are suitable for the analy- sis of glucose concentration within 48 hours. Sodium
Fluoride is used as a glycolysis inhibitor, whereas the additive is used to prevent the enzymatic
action in the glycolytic pathway.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.58]

###### GEL CLOT ACTIVATOR

Marcela gel and clot activator is used for routine blood donor screening as well as for diagnosing
infectious diseases. The gel barrier at the bottom of the tube is used to separate the serum and the
blood clot as the gel barrier is moving upward to the serum clot during centrifugation.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.57 (2)]

###### LITHIUM HEPARIN

Marcela lithium heparin tubes are used in chemistry and special chemis- try testing. Heparin is the
recommended anticoagulant for many deter- minations using whole blood or plasma specimens. Tubes are
sprayed with dried sodium heparin additives.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.55]

###### SODIUM HEPARIN

Marcela tubes containing sodium heparin are used for the collection of heparinised plasma or whole
blood for special tests like endocrine, meta- bolic disorders and generally routine tests. The
additive is anticoagulant which prevents clotting or activation of thrombin. Should not be used for
coagulation or hematology testing.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.55]

###### SODIUM CITRATE

Marcela Citrate tubes (3.2% and 3.8%) are used for coagulation studies and contain buffered
sodiumvcitrate solution. The citrate tubes can also be used to obtain an accurate platelet count
through a special test procedure.

[whatsapp image 2025 08 09 at 10.27.57 (1)]
[ To Know More Download Brochure ][15]

## Urine Collection Tubes

###### URINE COLLECTION

Marcela urine collection tubes allow the collection, transportation, and analysis of urine specimen
quickly, safely, and hygienically. The tube is sterile, leak proof and safe to use. Made of
polypropylene

[test2 (2)]

Tubes are vacuum, with a pre-defined collection volume, as per the requirement. They should be used
within 30-60 minutes from collection.

Urine tubes are available with no additive for an immediate analysis carried out after collection
or, with 1% boric acid to maintain sample up to 12 hours without the need to refrigerate.

The preservative is important when the sample cannot be analyzed within 2 hours from collection.

common agent causing acute hepatitis is virus. Of these Hepatitis B virus leads to severe forms of
disease. After incubation period of 1-6 months surface antigen (HBsAg) of Hepatitis B virus appears
in blood serving as first serological marker for detection & diagnosis of HBsAg in serum.

What is Hematology?

**Hematology**, also spelled *haematology*, is the branch of medicine concerned with the study of
the cause, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases related to blood. It involves treating
diseases that affect the production of blood and its components, such as blood cells, hemoglobin,
blood proteins, bone marrow, platelets, blood vessels, spleen, and the mechanism of coagulation.

Access structured reference articles, curated medical illustrations, and expert presentations
designed to streamline workflows and support complex differential diagnoses.

What is Hematology?

**Hematology**, also spelled *haematology*, is the branch of medicine concerned with the study of
the cause, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases related to blood. It involves treating
diseases that affect the production of blood and its components, such as blood cells, hemoglobin,
blood proteins, bone marrow, platelets, blood vessels, spleen, and the mechanism of coagulation.

## Your Trusted Mobile Partner

OnGo Diagnostics is a mobile phlebotomy service , offering in-home blood collection, urine drug
screens, and specimen pick-up for clients who value comfort, privacy, and reliability. Robin Green,
the founder and head phlebotomist, brings more than 20 years of medical experience and a deep-rooted
passion for caring for others. Robin began working in hospital settings before running a home care
agency, later teaching phlebotomy as an instructor. Motivated by a desire to make healthcare more
accessible, Robin established OnGo Diagnostics in 2020 - enabling clients to receive high-quality
lab services delivered by a skilled, friendly professional. Every appointment reflects a personal
touch, focused on the emotional and practical needs of each person, whether helping someone manage
diabetes, heart disease, or simply easing the stress of routine testing. Clients know they are in
safe and caring hands.

## Why Choose OnGo Diagnostics

### Convenience

Lab work happens on your terms, not the hospital's. OnGo Diagnostics saves clients from the trouble
of waiting rooms, long drives, or juggling busy schedules. Services are available directly at your
home or location of choice in Gainesville and nearby areas, supporting those with mobility or health
challenges.

### Compassion

Your comfort comes first in every interaction. With a caring and patient-centered approach, OnGo
Diagnostics understands medical visits can feel stressful or overwhelming. Friendly communication, a
gentle manner, and personalized support make each step as reassuring as possible - especially for
those managing chronic conditions.

### Affordability

Booking should be simple, and paying should be secure. OnGo Diagnostics offers instant online
scheduling, transparent pricing, and safe online payment options - all from your own device. Live
chat support and flexible bookings work around family and work commitments, so you stay in control.

drug screens, and specimen pick-up and drop-off at your home or chosen location. Backed by more than

seasoned, compassionate specialist, this service puts your comfort first. Clients of all ages and
health backgrounds benefit from flexible, 24/7 scheduling, easy online booking, and real-time direct
support. Each visit is guided by genuine concern, helping you stay healthy without the stress of
